'''Jerzy Browkin''' (5 November 1934 – 23 November 2015) was a Polish [[mathematician]], studying mainly [[algebraic number theory]]. He was a professor at the Institute of Mathematics of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]]. In 1994, together with Juliusz Brzeziński, he formulated the ''n''-conjecture—a version of the [[abc conjecture|''abc'' conjecture]] involving ''n''&nbsp;>&nbsp;2 integers.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ptm.org.pl/zawartosc/zmar%C5%82-profesor-jerzy-browkin-1934-2015|title=Zmarł Profesor Jerzy Browkin (1934-2015)|work=ptm.org.pl}}</ref>
